display.purpose: The painted board above the stall. Page H1 only; two-tone fluoro/tungsten. Uppercase is not optional.

headline.purpose: Section H2s. Same face and metrics as display, one step down.

title.purpose: Stall headings, method steps, in-page H2/H3.

lead.purpose: The first paragraph inside a stall or case study, set in fluoro rather than tarp-pale.

body.purpose: Reading prose in tarp-pale at 80-90% opacity. Written to an owner-operator, not a marketer.

label.purpose: Tag chips, disclaimers, docket source stamps, copyright.

eyebrow.purpose: Display face at 12px with 0.2em tracking. Category line, footer headings, back-links.

marker.purpose: The hand. Only things that would genuinely be hand-written on a stall: times, domains, counts, facts.

shadows.name: card-drop
shadows.purpose: Every price card. Zero blur — it is lying on a counter, not floating.

shadows.name: chop-body
shadows.purpose: The thickness of the rubber stamp under a primary WhatsApp chop. 0 7px 0 on the oversized closing CTA.

shadows.name: chop-pressed
shadows.purpose: Active state, paired with translateY(1px). The stamp is pressed.

shadows.name: bulb-glow
shadows.purpose: Emitted light sized to the bulb. The only blurred shadow in the system.

motion.name: sway
motion.value: sway 7s ease-in-out infinite (rotate -1.1deg to 1.1deg, transform-origin top center)
motion.purpose: Every awning. A tarpaulin moves because the lane moves.

motion.name: flicker
motion.value: flicker 9s linear infinite (opacity 1 -> 0.55 -> 0.9 in the last 7%)

motion.name: land
motion.purpose: A docket arriving on the counter. Firm decelerate, no overshoot — a card settles, it does not spring.

motion.name: gate-loop
motion.value: requestAnimationFrame, 5.4% lane-width per second, dt clamped to 0.05s
motion.purpose: The Gate's crowd. Deterministic seed so server and client first paint agree. Skipped entirely under reduced motion.

motion.name: cross-seam
motion.value: transition: opacity, transform 500ms; translateY(46px) scale(0.7) to opacity 0
motion.purpose: A walker crossing the seam downward into the stall.

motion.name: lift-stall
motion.purpose: Interactive stalls in the client lane.

motion.name: press-chop
motion.value: transition-transform; active: translateY(4px) with shadow collapse to 0 2px 0
motion.purpose: The primary chop. Pressing, not hovering, is the gesture.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { *, *::before, *::after { animation-duration: 0.001ms !important; animation-iteration-count: 1 !important; transition-duration: 0.001ms !important; scroll-behavior: auto !important; } }
motion.purpose: Everything stops. No exceptions and no !important re-enables anywhere in the codebase.

components.name: The Chop (primary WhatsApp CTA)
components.description: The only conversion control in the system, and the only place chop green is allowed. A rubber stamp you press.
components.css: .ds-chop-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-family: Archivo, 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-weight: 900; font-size: 16px; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-decoration: none; background: var(--color-chop, #25d366); color: var(--color-ink, #0d0619); border: 3px solid var(--color-chop-deep, #128c48); border-radius: 6px; padding: 14px 24px; box-shadow: 0 6px 0 var(--color-chop-deep, #128c48); transition: transform 0.15s; } .ds-chop-primary:active { transform: translateY(4px); box-shadow: 0 2px 0 var(--color-chop-deep, #128c48); } .ds-chop-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-tungsten-hot, #ffe3a8); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 2px; }

components.name: The Chop (outline)
components.description: Secondary action. Same stamped object, unfilled, in tungsten — because tungsten is the wayfinding colour and chop green is reserved.
components.css: .ds-chop-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; font-family: Archivo, 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-weight: 900; font-size: 16px; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-decoration: none; color: var(--color-tungsten, #ffb13c); background: transparent; border: 3px solid currentColor; border-radius: 6px; padding: 12px 20px; transition: transform 0.15s, color 0.15s; } .ds-chop-outline:hover { color: var(--color-tungsten-hot, #ffe3a8); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-chop-outline:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-tungsten-hot, #ffe3a8); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: The Stall
components.description: The system's universal container: scalloped swaying awning, fluorescent tube, lit counter. Replaces the feature card everywhere.
components.html:
Man the counter

You are with a customer. The phone goes. That one is gone.

  • Booking systems
  • CRM & follow-up
components.css: .ds-stall { display: flex; flex-direction: column; max-width: 360px; } .ds-stall-awning { height: 24px; flex-shrink: 0; background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, var(--color-tarp, #1d6fb8) 0 18px, var(--color-tarp-pale, #eaf2fb) 18px 36px); -webkit-mask-image: radial-gradient(circle at 11px 100%, transparent 0 10px, #000 10.5px); mask-image: radial-gradient(circle at 11px 100%, transparent 0 10px, #000 10.5px); -webkit-mask-size: 22px 14px; mask-size: 22px 14px; -webkit-mask-repeat: repeat-x; mask-repeat: repeat-x; -webkit-mask-position: bottom; mask-position: bottom; transform-origin: top center; animation: ds-sway 7s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-sway { 0%,100% { transform: rotate(-1.1deg); } 50% { transform: rotate(1.1deg); } } .ds-stall-tube { height: 8px; flex-shrink: 0; background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--color-fluoro, #e9f5ff) 0 2px, rgba(233,245,255,0.85) 2px 4px, rgba(233,245,255,0.25) 4px 6px, transparent 6px); } .ds-stall-counter { flex: 1; padding: 20px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(233,245,255,0.2) 0%, rgba(233,245,255,0.07) 16%, rgba(233,245,255,0.02) 34%, transparent 60%), var(--color-plum-lit, #4d2069); } .ds-stall-title { margin: 0; font-family: Archivo, 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-weight: 900; font-stretch: 75%; font-size: 24px; line-height: 0.88; letter-spacing: -0.015em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-fluoro, #e9f5ff); } .ds-stall-lead { margin: 16px 0 0; font-family: 'Be Vietnam Pro', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.625; color: var(--color-fluoro, #e9f5ff); } .ds-stall-tags { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; margin: 20px 0 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; } .ds-stall-tags li { border: 1px solid rgba(255,177,60,0.45); padding: 4px 8px; font-family: 'Be Vietnam Pro', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-tarp-pale, #eaf2fb); } a:hover > .ds-stall { transform: translateY(-4px); }

components.name: Price Card
components.description: Fluorescent stock, marker hand, hard drop shadow, always slightly crooked. Used for docket rows, built-items, and honest notes.
components.css: .ds-price-card { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; min-width: 200px; padding: 8px 12px; background: var(--color-card-stock, #fff8e6); color: var(--color-ink, #0d0619); font-family: 'Shantell Sans', 'Comic Sans MS', cursive; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; border-radius: 0; box-shadow: 0 3px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.45); transform: rotate(-0.5deg); } .ds-price-card-time { font-size: 16px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-price-card-source { background: var(--color-ink, #0d0619); color: var(--color-card-stock, #fff8e6); font-family: 'Be Vietnam Pro', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px; }

components.name: Tag Chip
components.description: The lightest object in the system: the only 1px border, square-cut, tungsten at 45%. Lists capabilities without competing with anything.
components.css: .ds-tags { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; } .ds-tags li { border: 1px solid rgba(255,177,60,0.45); border-radius: 0; padding: 4px 8px; font-family: 'Be Vietnam Pro', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-tarp-pale, #eaf2fb); }

components.name: Stamped Label
components.description: The chop shape used as a stamp rather than a control: the Gate's 'the gate' marker and its pink example-data disclaimer. Disclaimers are stamped, never set as fine print.
components.html: the gateExample — not real client data

components.name: Law Toggle
components.description: The Gate's two switches. On is chop green (it is the counter being answered); off is pink and struck through. The only place chop green appears outside a WhatsApp link, and only because it means 'someone is answering'.
components.css: .ds-laws { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; } .ds-law { font-family: Archivo, 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.02em; background: transparent; color: var(--color-chop, #25d366); border: 3px solid var(--color-chop, #25d366); border-radius: 6px; padding: 6px 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.2s, border-color 0.2s; } .ds-law-off { color: var(--color-card-pink, #ff3d8b); border-color: var(--color-card-pink, #ff3d8b); text-decoration: line-through; text-decoration-thickness: 2px; } .ds-law:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-tungsten-hot, #ffe3a8); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding: 16px; } .ds-nav-brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; text-decoration: none; color: var(--color-fluoro, #e9f5ff); } .ds-mark { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; background: var(--color-tungsten, #ffb13c); color: var(--color-ink, #0d0619); font-family: Archivo, 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-weight: 900; font-stretch: 75%; font-size: 18px; text-transform: uppercase; clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 6%, 96% 100%, 4% 94%); } .ds-nav-word { font-family: Archivo, 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-weight: 900; font-stretch: 75%; font-size: 20px; letter-spacing: -0.025em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-nav-right { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; } .ds-nav-link { font-family: 'Be Vietnam Pro', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; color: rgba(234,242,251,0.8); transition: color 0.2s; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: var(--color-fluoro, #e9f5ff); } .ds-nav-chop { font-family: Archivo, 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-weight: 900; font-size: 14px; text-decoration: none; background: var(--color-chop, #25d366); color: var(--color-ink, #0d0619); border: 3px solid var(--color-chop, #25d366); border-radius: 6px; padding: 6px 16px; transition: transform 0.15s; } .ds-nav-chop:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible, .ds-nav-chop:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-tungsten-hot, #ffe3a8); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: String Lights
components.description: Bulbs glow because bulbs glow: an object with a light source, sized to the bulb, never a decorative wash. The unlit variant loses the shadow entirely.
components.css: .ds-string { display: flex; gap: 22px; padding: 12px 8px; } .ds-bulb { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-tungsten-hot, #ffe3a8); box-shadow: 0 0 6px 1px var(--color-tungsten, #ffb13c), 0 0 14px 3px rgba(255,177,60,0.42); animation: ds-flicker 9s linear infinite; } .ds-bulb:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 0.7s; } .ds-bulb:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 1.4s; } .ds-bulb:nth-child(4) { animation-delay: 2.1s; } .ds-bulb:nth-child(5) { animation-delay: 2.8s; } .ds-bulb-dim { background: #6a5233; box-shadow: none; animation: none; } @keyframes ds-flicker { 0%, 93%, 100% { opacity: 1; } 95% { opacity: 0.55; } 97% { opacity: 0.9; } }

narrative.overview:
A Malaysian night market just after the lights go on. The sky is still bleeding indigo into plum, the string bulbs are already hot, and every stall is a striped tarpaulin awning over a fluorescent tube over a counter with hand-written cards on it. The page is that lane. The visitor is walking down it. Blueprint is the stall that is lit and staffed while the others are shuttered.

The system is drenched, not neutral. There is no grey, no white card on a dark background, no surface that exists only to hold content. The background is a painted sky gradient; every panel is a coloured object with a reason to be that colour. Depth comes from light — a tube throws a wash down onto a counter, a bulb glows because bulbs glow — never from soft ambient shadow. Density is generous and physical: things are stacked (awning, tube, counter), pinned (cards, always slightly crooked), and stamped (the chop, a rubber stamp with a 3px border).

The confirmed anti-reference is the site this replaced: a dark-navy / cyan / Space Grotesk drafting-blueprint vernacular with a feature-card grid. That world was destroyed deliberately. Its two signatures — the neutral card grid and the hairline technical-drawing look — are the two things this world must never drift back toward. The stall replaced the card, and light replaced the hairline.
keyCharacteristics: Drenched dusk palette: indigo → plum → lit-plum, with tungsten amber as the only warmth
The stall (awning → tube → lit counter) as the universal container, not the card
Three hands of type: a condensed black shout, a plain reading face, a hand-written marker
Hard, zero-blur offset shadows; blur only where there is a light source
WhatsApp green reserved exclusively for the conversion action
Motion is ambient and slow (sway, flicker), and stops completely under reduced motion

rules.name: The Reserved Chop Rule
rules.body: Chop green and chop-deep are WhatsApp's own green and they belong to the WhatsApp action alone. They appear on the hero chop, the sticky chop, the nav chop, the closing chop, the case-study chop, the footer WhatsApp line, and the "someone's at the counter" law when it is on — nothing else. Never use chop green for a heading, a border, a chart, a hover state, or a decorative accent. Its scarcity is what makes it a button on sight.

rules.name: The Lit Counter Rule
rules.body: The stall counter is plum-lit with a fluoro wash falling from the top. It must always be lighter than the sky around it. A dark counter panel would make the whole metaphor lie.

rules.name: The Amber Wayfinding Rule
rules.body: Tungsten is the only emphasis colour that may appear more than once per screen. If something needs attention and is not the WhatsApp action, it is amber.

rules.name: The Three Hands Rule
rules.body: Archivo shouts, Be Vietnam Pro reads, Shantell Sans writes the numbers by hand. A font never takes another's job: no Archivo paragraphs, no Be Vietnam headings, no Shantell body copy.

rules.name: The Hand-Written Number Rule
rules.body: Anything that would be written by hand on a real stall is set in the marker face: docket times, the method's running order, client domains, case-study facts. Numbers that are UI stay in Be Vietnam Pro. Tabular figures are applied wherever numbers change in place.

rules.name: The Shout-Is-Uppercase Rule
rules.body: The display class carries text-transform: uppercase — never override it. Sentence-case Archivo reads as a mistake, not a variation.

rules.name: The One Geometry Rule
rules.body: Lane → seam → stall holds at every width. No breakpoint may reorder it, stack it differently, or hide the lane on mobile. If a layout only works at one width, it is the wrong layout.

rules.name: The Thumb-Zone Rule
rules.body: The WhatsApp chop is reachable without scrolling on every screen of the site. The buyer is reading on a phone between appointments.

rules.name: The Hard Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are offset and unblurred. Blur is reserved for light sources — a bulb may glow; a panel may not.

rules.name: The Light-Source Rule
rules.body: Every glow in the build belongs to an object that would emit light in the real lane. Do not add ambient bloom, backdrop blur, or a glow behind a heading to create emphasis; use tungsten instead.

rules.name: The Crooked Card Rule
rules.body: A price card is never at 0°. Rotate 0.4°–2°, and alternate the sign in a sequence so a list looks dealt rather than tiled.

rules.name: The Semantic Radius Rule
rules.body: Zero radius by default. 6px means pressable; a circle means lit. Never round a container to soften it.

rules.name: The Full Stop Rule
rules.body: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, everything stops — one global block killing animation, transition and scroll-behaviour, with no !important re-enables anywhere. The replaced site had two. The composition must read as a deliberate still with nothing running.

rules.name: The Stall-Not-Card Rule
rules.body: New repeating content gets a stall. If you find yourself reaching for a bordered rectangle with a title and body, you have reintroduced the feature-card grid this world was built to destroy.

rules.name: The Drawn-Not-Stocked Rule
rules.body: People are drawn as figures; icons are inline SVG. No stock photography, no illustration library, no placeholder imagery.

dos: Do build any new repeating content as a stall: scalloped swaying awning → fluoro tube → plum-lit counter.
Do keep the counter the brightest opaque surface in its neighbourhood.
Do use tungsten for every emphasis and wayfinding cue that is not the WhatsApp action.
Do hand-letter in Shantell Sans anything that would be hand-written on a real stall — times, domains, counts, facts — and apply .tabular when a number changes in place.
Do rotate price cards 0.4°–2° and alternate the direction down a list.
Do use offset, zero-blur shadows for weight, and reserve blur for objects that emit light.
Do stamp disclaimers in the chop shape (pink border, pink text) rather than shrinking them into fine print.
Do end every primary CTA in a WhatsApp link with a prefilled message.
Do render a missing fact as an honest note in the world's own vocabulary — the "On results" price card — rather than omitting the section or filling it.
Do keep body text above 4.5:1: tarp-pale at /65 or higher at 12px, /80 or higher for prose.
donts: Don't use chop green or chop-deep for anything other than the WhatsApp conversion action. Not a heading, not a border, not a hover, not a chart.
Don't put a dark panel where a counter belongs.
Don't reintroduce the neutral bordered feature-card grid, hairline technical rules, or the navy/cyan/Space Grotesk vernacular of the replaced site.
Don't add !important re-enables inside the reduced-motion block, or exempt a "subtle" animation from it.
Don't override the display class's uppercase, or set body copy in Archivo or Shantell.
Don't add ambient blur, backdrop-filter, or a glow behind text to create emphasis.
Don't ship a stock photo, an illustration-library asset, or a grey placeholder box. Every image in this system is drawn SVG until real client photography exists.

Don't print a number, sector, location, or outcome that is not user-confirmed. lib/clients.ts enforces this with detail: null and outcomes: null; lib/site.ts enforces it by falling back to http://localhost:4310 rather than a guessed production domain.
